source.title: WCA Quality Assurance Committee Call for Applicants - (September 2026)
source.content:
# WCA Quality Assurance Committee Volunteer Positions Available

The WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) is seeking up to six Volunteers to fill open positions on the Committee. Joining the WQAC is a great way to get started as a new WCA Volunteer, or to explore new ways to contribute to the WCA Community if you are already a WCA Volunteer. 

**What does the WQAC do?**

The WQAC is responsible for developing educational resources to support the WCA Community and advising in situations when WCA Volunteers are not maintaining the skills required for their positions. The official rights and duties of the WQAC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2025.8](https://worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.8). Each member is expected to contribute approximately 4-5 hours per week to committee-related work. 

**Am I qualified to apply to the WQAC?**

The main requirements for applying to the WQAC are that you are at least 18 years of age and are proficient in writing English. We are most interested in applicants who have strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and collaboration skills. Each open position below has other specific requirements applicable only to that position. 

<!-- break -->

## Open Positions

**Inquiries (formerly Investigations) Team Leader (1 position)**

The Inquiries Team handles concerns related to the quality of WCA competitions, Delegate conduct that does not violate the Code of Ethics or Code of Conduct, adherence to the WCA Scramble Accountability Policy (WSAP), and other issues not directly overseen by other Committees or Teams. This team is shifting from a more direct approach to investigating issues to assisting Regional and Senior Delegates as they begin to directly address region-specific issues on their own. This position would report directly to the WQAC Leader. This role is perfect for current or former WCA Volunteers who wish to help support various regions and WCA Committees and Teams with various issues they might encounter. 

**We are looking for applicants who:**

- Have experience leading a small diverse team. 

- Have strong knowledge of the role and responsibilities of a WCA Delegate. 

- Have strong analytical and critical thinking skills, including an understanding of cognitive bias. 

- Are willing to assign team members to a variety of tasks. 

- Are able to regularly check on the progress of inquiries. 

- Are able to check email and Slack daily. 

- Are able to communicate professionally and clearly through email. 

**LMS Administrator (1 to 3 positions)**

The Learning Management System (LMS) Project team has released the first training course for Trainee Delegates ready to be promoted to Junior Delegate. As the course catalog grows, it is becoming increasingly urgent to appoint at least one additional experienced administrator for our LMS Platform, Moodle. We are in need of one to three experienced individuals to help maintain the current Trainee-to-Junior course and help create future courses. Individuals selected for this position will also be expected to routinely collaborate with various teams to add and improve course content, evaluate the current question bank, and update content as policies and practices evolve. This position will report directly to the LMS Project Leader. This role is perfect for current or aspiring educators who have experience in online course development. 

We are looking for applicants who: 

- Have experience with Moodle or another similar LMS. 

- Have experience collaborating with multiple teams to update course content as needed. 

- Have strong knowledge of the WCA Delegate role (preferred, but not required if you have extensive curriculum or LMS experience). 

- Have experience in curriculum design. 

- Have experience with HTML/CSS/JavaScript. 

Individual applicants do not need to have all the experience and qualities above, as long as the selected individuals collectively cover them. 

**WQAC Policy Maintainer (1 to 2 positions)**

With the launch of the LMS and in anticipation of future updates to WQAC-maintained policies, we need a dedicated Policy Maintainer. The WQAC maintains two WCA policies: the WCA Scramble Accountability Policy (WSAP) and the soon-to-be-implemented WCA Delegate Management Policy (WDMP). The Policy Maintainer would be responsible for routinely collaborating with the WQAC Leader and the Subteam Leaders, and would report to the EduDocs Team Leader. They would adjust and add sections to the WSAP and WDMP as needed. This position is best suited for those who want a more administrative role within the WQAC. 

We are looking for applicants who: 

- Have experience working with GitHub and Markdown. 

- Have experience working in Google Workspace, mainly Google Docs and Sheets. 

- Are able to work independently and collaboratively as needed. 

- Have experience writing and maintaining policy documents. 

- Have a strong knowledge of the current WCA Documents. 

- Have a strong knowledge of the WCA Delegate role. 

This position can be split into two if necessary: One individual who maintains the WSAP, and another individual who maintains the WDMP. 

### Application Process

Interested candidates can submit applications using this **[Google Form](https://forms.gle/5GPiArFu6mb13iAVA)** The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents for all positions will be open **until the Google Form is closed** . Questions regarding the application or the open positions can be sent to Roxana Johnson (rjohnson@worldcubeassociation.org). 

The Google Form will require applicants to provide the following information: 

1. **Personal Introduction:** A brief summary of who you are and your professional background. 

2. **WCA Experience:** A summary of any past activities or roles held within the WCA. While helpful, prior WCA experience is not a requirement for any of these roles. 

3. **Time Commitment:** The approximate number of hours per week you can commit to WQAC volunteer work. 

4. **Role:** The role you are applying to and the reasons you are fit for it. 

Qualified candidates will be selected for interviews. Selected candidates will be added to the WQAC on a rolling basis.

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会招募申请人（2026 年 9 月）
translation.content:
# WCA 质量保证委员会志愿者岗位招募

WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）正在招募最多六名志愿者，填补委员会的空缺岗位。对于新加入 WCA 的志愿者，WQAC 是一个很好的起点；对于现有 WCA 志愿者，加入 WQAC 也是探索其他方式为 WCA 社区作贡献的机会。

**WQAC 负责什么？**

WQAC 负责开发支持 WCA 社区的教育资源，并在 WCA 志愿者未能保持岗位所需技能时提供建议。WQAC 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 议案 10.2025.8](https://worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.8)。每位成员预计每周投入约 4—5 小时处理委员会事务。

**我是否符合申请 WQAC 的条件？**

申请 WQAC 的主要要求是年满 18 岁，并具备熟练的英语写作能力。我们尤其看重细致认真、解决问题和协作的能力。下列各空缺岗位还有各自的具体要求。

## 空缺岗位

**问询团队负责人（原调查团队，1 个名额）**

问询团队处理与 WCA 比赛质量、未违反《道德准则》或《行为准则》的代表行为、《WCA 打乱问责政策》（WSAP）的遵守情况，以及其他没有由别的委员会或团队直接负责的问题有关的事项。该团队正从更直接地调查问题，转向协助区域代表和高级代表，由他们开始自行直接处理所在地区的问题。该岗位直接向 WQAC 负责人汇报。如果您曾经或正在 WCA 担任志愿者，并希望帮助各地区、委员会及团队解决问题，这一岗位很适合您。

**我们希望申请人：**

- 有领导小型、多元团队的经验。
- 深入了解 WCA 代表的角色与职责。
- 具备较强的分析与批判性思考能力，包括对认知偏差的理解。
- 愿意为团队成员分配不同任务。
- 能定期跟进问询事项的进展。
- 能每天查看电子邮件和 Slack。
- 能通过电子邮件进行专业、清晰的沟通。

**学习管理系统（LMS）管理员（1—3 个名额）**

学习管理系统（LMS）项目团队已发布首门培训课程，面向准备晋升为初级代表的见习代表。随着课程数量增加，为我们的 LMS 平台 Moodle 至少增设一名有经验的管理员，已变得愈加迫切。我们需要一至三名有经验的人员，协助维护现有的见习代表升初级代表课程，并帮助创建后续课程。入选者还需经常与不同团队合作，增补、改进课程内容，评估现有题库，并随着政策与实践的发展更新内容。该岗位向 LMS 项目负责人汇报。对于有在线课程开发经验的现任教育工作者或有志投身教育的人士，这一岗位非常合适。

我们希望申请人：

- 有使用 Moodle 或其他类似 LMS 的经验。
- 有与多个团队协作、按需更新课程内容的经验。
- 深入了解 WCA 代表的角色（优先考虑；若具有丰富的课程或 LMS 经验，则不作硬性要求）。
- 有课程设计经验。
- 有 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 使用经验。

每位申请人不必满足上述所有条件，只要最终录用的团队成员合起来具备这些经验和能力即可。

**WQAC 政策维护人员（1—2 个名额）**

随着 LMS 上线，以及 WQAC 负责的政策即将迎来更新，我们需要专门的政策维护人员。WQAC 负责维护两项 WCA 政策：《WCA 打乱问责政策》（WSAP）及即将实施的《WCA 代表管理政策》（WDMP）。政策维护人员需经常与 WQAC 负责人及各分组负责人协作，并向 EduDocs 团队负责人汇报。他们将根据需要调整、增补 WSAP 和 WDMP 的条款。该岗位最适合希望在 WQAC 承担更多行政事务的人士。

我们希望申请人：

- 有使用 GitHub 和 Markdown 的经验。
- 有使用 Google Workspace 的经验，主要是 Google Docs 和 Sheets。
- 能独立工作，也能按需协作。
- 有编写、维护政策文件的经验。
- 熟悉现行 WCA 文件。
- 深入了解 WCA 代表的角色。

必要时可将该岗位分为两个：一人维护 WSAP，另一人维护 WDMP。

### 申请流程

有意者可通过这份 **[Google 表单](https://forms.gle/5GPiArFu6mb13iAVA)** 提交申请。所有岗位的申请材料均可持续提交，**直至该 Google 表单关闭**。有关申请或空缺岗位的问题，请联系 Roxana Johnson（rjohnson@worldcubeassociation.org）。

Google 表单要求申请人提供以下信息：

1. **个人介绍：** 简要介绍自己及职业背景。
2. **WCA 经历：** 概述过去参与 WCA 的活动或担任过的角色。既往 WCA 经历有帮助，但不是任何这些岗位的必要条件。
3. **可投入时间：** 每周大约能投入多少小时参与 WQAC 志愿工作。
4. **岗位：** 所申请的岗位，以及自己适合这一岗位的理由。

符合条件的候选人将被选中参加面试。入选者将分批加入 WQAC。
